name: Lavender Melon
description: A brightly-colored fruit. The flesh within transforms into food with a unique mouthfeel when cooked.
fullDescription: A fruit with gorgeous skin. The flesh within transforms into food with a unique mouthfeel when cooked.\nIn Inazuma, there is a traditional art that involves using the outer skins of these fruits to make dye. They say that Konda Village once planted Lavender Melons and that they were famed for their secret "Konda Dye" art, by which they produced truly lovely fabric.
sources: Found in the wild in Inazuma
